decision_rule: Stars indicate discovery, not adoption. Adoption requires official-source verification, license review, least privilege, an owner, and a rollback test.

tools.name: OpenClaw
tools.risk: Broad tool permissions and plugin supply chain
tools.control: Role allowlists, pinned versions, no autonomous production writes

tools.name: Hermes Agent
tools.fit: Local-first reasoning gateway and reusable skills
tools.risk: Local-model quality ceiling and cloud fallback billing
tools.control: Local primary, explicit cloud budget, verified skill bundles

tools.name: n8n
tools.fit: Existing notification and low-risk integration wiring
tools.risk: Credential sprawl and uncontrolled workflow writes
tools.control: Read-only collectors first; credential scopes per workflow

tools.name: Temporal
tools.risk: Premature infrastructure complexity
tools.control: Introduce only after replay/SLO pressure is proven and ADR approved

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.risk: Write-capable tokens
tools.control: Read-only and lockdown modes

tools.name: Context7
tools.risk: External content is untrusted
tools.control: Use as evidence input, never as execution authority

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.risk: Can mutate accounts and publish data
tools.control: Filtered tools and human approval for writes

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.risk: Overlaps Playwright and expands attack surface
tools.control: Adopt only for an unmet diagnostic use case

tools.name: Langfuse
tools.license: Review current repository license before production
tools.fit: Agent traces, quality and cost telemetry
tools.risk: Prompt and customer-data leakage
tools.control: Redaction, self-host boundary, retention policy

tools.name: Promptfoo
tools.risk: Bad test sets create false confidence
tools.control: Real failure cases and shadow-run evidence

tools.name: Trivy
tools.fit: Dependency, image, IaC and secret scanning
tools.risk: Scanner findings need triage
tools.control: Severity policy and documented suppressions

tools.name: dlt
tools.risk: Another abstraction before source contracts stabilize
tools.control: Use after two production connectors prove repeated ETL needs

tools.name: pgvector
tools.fit: Evidence retrieval inside the existing database boundary
tools.risk: Premature vectorization and weak source provenance
tools.control: Exact/FTS search first; ADR and retrieval benchmark required

tools.name: Opik
tools.risk: Duplicates the Langfuse/Promptfoo split
tools.control: Do not install without a capability comparison

tools.name: TensorZero
tools.risk: Duplicates current gateway and adds operational complexity
tools.control: Benchmark only after model traffic and feedback volume justify it

tools.name: TrendRadar
tools.risk: License boundary and secondary-source noise
tools.control: No code mixing; use only as a discovery benchmark

tools.name: RAGFlow
tools.risk: Large platform before retrieval needs are measured
tools.control: Benchmark against existing SQLite/PostgreSQL search first

tools.name: browser-use
tools.risk: Non-determinism and account mutation
tools.control: Read-only sandbox and task-specific benchmark

tools.name: Gemini CLI
tools.risk: Overlapping agent surface and credential sprawl
tools.control: Evaluate, do not add to the production control plane

tools.name: Grok Build
tools.license: Apache-2.0 for first-party code; third-party notices remain applicable
tools.fit: Independent coding-agent benchmark, worktree isolation, headless JSON output and ACP research
tools.risk: Overlapping agent authority, credential sprawl, project instruction compatibility and unpinned auto-updates
tools.control: Developer workstation only; inspect before use; no production credentials; read-only benchmark first; writes only in disposable worktrees; never join the KJDS production control plane without an accepted ADR
